objective: Add a bounded, explicitly heuristic confidence and abstention boundary to owner-triggered screen Vision so uncertain descriptions remain visible as untrusted reference text but cannot enter fresh chat context or become decision-support evidence.
non_goals: Do not calibrate semantic confidence or claim the M08 scene-QA gate has passed in this slice.
Do not enable automatic capture, OCR, game control or autonomous decisions.
Do not change the configured Cloud/local Vision provider, text brain, STT, TTS or VRAM budgets.
Do not run deep all-on, soak or release verification.
contracts: Every requested Vision result exposes state, bounded summary, confidence, confidence source, calibration flag, threshold and an optional bounded abstention reason; unavailable/error/not-requested results never invent confidence.
The confidence score is a deterministic conservative heuristic over final visible text, is explicitly marked uncalibrated, and cannot be represented as semantic accuracy.
Explicit inability statements, severely underspecified summaries or a score below the fixed threshold produce state=abstained and decisionSupportEligible=false.
Only state=ready Vision summaries can enter the same-session owner fresh-context path within the existing fifteen-second TTL; abstained text never enters chat memory, replay, TTS or decision support.
The Dashboard distinguishes provider failure from abstention, shows the heuristic percentage and reason in plain Vietnamese, and disables the ask-about-capture action for abstained results.
allowed_dependencies: Python standard library, existing Vue/TypeScript desktop stack and existing repository test tooling.
acceptance_criteria: A complete, sufficiently detailed Vision summary remains ready and exposes uncalibrated heuristic confidence at or above the threshold.
A model response that explicitly says the image cannot be determined becomes abstained, remains untrusted reference text in the capture result, and is absent from fresh_context_for_turn.
Provider errors retain their existing error codes and are not mislabeled as abstention.
Desktop capture messaging and the Perception page render ready, abstained and error as three distinct states without exposing prompt, reasoning, pixels, source ID or API key.
Perception unit tests, desktop typecheck/build/tests, module-brief validation and git diff check pass.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M08-S23-vision-confidence-abstention-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s workers/perception/tests -p "test_*.py"
uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s apps/core-runtime/tests -p "test_perception_routes.py"
